_note: Service + Route + netpol/egress. Routes RBAC + NetworkPolicy + app ingress are lifted from the workshop's session.objects by deploy_workshop (authored_session_extras). verify-egress-blocked PASSES on the real air-gapped DCS platform (egress blocked). Only on a cluster with internet egress (e.g. local CRC) does it fail — the grader itself prints an environment-difference message in that case.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s

oc exec deploy/hello-dcs -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('https://example.com', timeout=5)" > ~/exercises/egress.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> ~/exercises/egress.txt; cat ~/exercises/egress.txt
